intro: Home tuition work around Itanagar follows one highway corridor, which we split into four zones. Itanagar North takes in Chimpu, Chandranagar, Vivek Vihar and Ganga Market; Central Itanagar covers E-Sector, Bank Tinali, C-Sector, Zero Point and Niti Vihar; the Naharlagun zone runs from Papu Nallah and Barapani to Polo Colony and Naharlagun itself; and the towns towards Assam are Nirjuli, Banderdewa and Doimukh. Many families live in government quarters and officers' colonies, where a gate asks for a visitor's name, so expect the parent to pass yours on. Independent houses on the slopes mean you walk straight to the door. Shared taxis and autos make the work possible without a vehicle.

On boards, start with CBSE. Its official affiliation overview lists the government schools of Arunachal Pradesh among CBSE-affiliated schools, and CBSE conducts the Class 10 and Class 12 examinations for its schools, so a tutor here should know the NCERT books, the sample papers and the marking schemes well. School education in the state follows the uniform 10+2 structure. A student may still follow CISCE's ICSE or ISC, the IB or an IGCSE syllabus, and you can take such learners at home or online if you know that board. Ask the family which board the school follows before the demo, not after it.

Two things shape a tutor's week here: the weather and the highway. Hill roads slow down in heavy monsoon rain, and the evening rush at Bank Tinali, Ganga Market and the Naharlagun market junction pushes many lessons to early evening or weekends, so tutors who offer home and online lessons can keep a timetable steady. Suppose a Polo Colony parent sends a request: NXTutors puts forward two or three tutors, searching that locality first, then the Naharlagun zone, the capital region and finally online. Your fee is on show before the free first demo, and a later switch costs the family nothing. Online students can be anywhere in India.

zone_notes.Itanagar North (Chimpu & Ganga): Chimpu, Chandranagar and Vivek Vihar have many government staff colonies, so expect to give your name at a gate and ask the parent to tell the guard before your first visit. Ganga Market is the travel base for tutors without a vehicle, with a shared-taxi counter and an auto stand. Vivek Vihar's hilltop part is reached by internal roads that slow in heavy rain, and office and market traffic on NH-52A favours mid-afternoon or weekend slots.
zone_notes.Central Itanagar: This is the office heart of the capital, with E-Sector opposite the Civil Secretariat, so the highway and the Bank Tinali junction are busiest at the start and end of the working day; plan lessons for early evening or weekends. Official compounds in Niti Vihar, E-Sector and C-Sector may register visitors at the gate. Parking is tight near the C-Sector market, while Niti Vihar is quieter. Visits in neighbouring sectors can often share one evening.
zone_notes.Naharlagun & Papu Nallah: Shared taxis run the highway between Itanagar and Naharlagun, so you can get down at Papu Nallah or the Barapani market and walk to most homes. For G Extension, E Sector and Polo Colony, take an auto from the daily market up the link roads. Government quarters and independent houses mix across the zone, with gates at official colonies. Tutors living on Itanagar's Zero Point side can also cover Papu Nallah and Barapani.
zone_notes.Nirjuli, Banderdewa & Doimukh: These are smaller towns on NH-415 towards Assam. In Nirjuli, campus and staff housing usually registers visitors at the gate, so send your name ahead; private houses near the highway mean doorstep arrival. Doimukh has fewer local tutors, so a tutor based in Naharlagun or Nirjuli who offers a fixed weekly slot plus online classes suits families there. If you are coming from outside the state, check the official rules first, as visitors from outside may need a permit.

boards: CBSE is the board an Itanagar tutor needs to know first: CBSE's own overview lists Arunachal Pradesh's government schools among its affiliated schools, and the board conducts the Class 10 and Class 12 examinations, with the syllabus, sample papers and marking schemes on its academic website. Schooling follows the 10+2 structure. A student may instead follow CISCE's ICSE and ISC, the IB Diploma or Cambridge or Pearson Edexcel IGCSE; read each on its own official site and confirm the school's board with the family. List on your profile the boards and classes you take.

board_cards.name: CBSE
board_cards.note: CBSE's official affiliation overview lists Arunachal Pradesh's government schools among its affiliated schools, and CBSE conducts the Class 10 and Class 12 examinations. Build lessons on NCERT chapters, rehearse with CBSE's own sample question papers and marking schemes, and train students to set out full, stepped answers that show every step of the working.

board_cards.name: CISCE (ICSE and ISC)
board_cards.note: If an Itanagar student follows CISCE, expect long written papers across a wide syllabus, set literature in English, and internal project work in several subjects. You can take such students at home within your own zone or online. Read the regulations and specimen papers on cisce.org rather than relying on forwarded copies.

board_cards.name: IB Diploma Programme
board_cards.note: IB Diploma learners can be taught from Itanagar online as well as at home. Coursework counts with the final exams: you may coach a student through the criteria for the Internal Assessment and the Extended Essay, but the work must stay the student's own. Plan from each subject guide published on ibo.org and the command terms it lists.

board_cards.name: Cambridge / Pearson Edexcel IGCSE
board_cards.note: For an IGCSE student, first confirm whether the school uses Cambridge or Pearson Edexcel, as their syllabuses differ. Lessons centre on timed past papers checked against the published mark schemes, on what each command word asks for, and on entering the right tier. Online lessons let you reach such learners anywhere.

women.intro: NXTutors welcomes women tutors across the Itanagar capital region for home, online or hybrid work. You choose the localities on your profile: a tutor living in Naharlagun might keep to Polo Colony, Barapani and the market sectors, while one in Vivek Vihar might stay within Itanagar North and teach everyone else online. Many homes here are in government colonies with a gate and a visitor register, and every new student starts with a demo for which we ask a parent to be at home. Every tutor who joins goes through the same ID check. These are practical controls you set and use, not promises about any family.
points: Choose home, online or hybrid teaching, and change it whenever your plans change.
List only the localities you are happy to reach, for example the sectors around one market rather than the whole highway.
Keep the timings on your profile realistic, and shift lessons earlier in the monsoon if the hill roads slow down.
Each new family begins with a free demo, and we ask a parent to be at home during it.
Settle money, the timetable and any change of plan with the parent, never through the child.
Hold lessons for young children in a common room of the house with a grown-up at home, and keep video on in online classes.
Registration asks for a one-time code by phone or email plus a government photo ID, checked by the team before the Verified badge appears.
Should anything make you uneasy, end the class, leave, and send NXTutors a report headed Safeguarding; for emergencies, dial 112 before anything else.

story: Sign up on your phone with a one-time code sent to your number or email, then add your subjects, classes, boards such as CBSE, and the Itanagar, Naharlagun or Nirjuli localities you can reach every week.

Next comes a government photo ID, which the team looks over before your profile is marked Verified, and which can sit on just one tutor account. This step establishes identity; it is not a police or background check.
Once approved, your profile carries the Verified badge and shows families your boards, the localities you cover from Chimpu to Doimukh, whether you teach at home, online or both, and your own fee.
A parent in E-Sector or Barapani sends a request. NXTutors draws up two or three names, starting with tutors closest to that locality, then widening to the zone, the capital region and online.
Your fee is visible to the parent before they book. The opening lesson is a free demo in their house, with a parent asked to be at home, so you can judge the student, the family and the journey.
After that, teach in homes along the highway that you can reach, online for learners anywhere in India, or both, for instance home lessons through term and online classes on very wet monsoon days.
faqs: How does a tuition request in Itanagar reach me?

Through a parent's request listing class, board, subjects, locality and whether lessons are at home, online or mixed. NXTutors answers it with two or three tutors, searching the same locality, then its zone, then the wider capital region, then online. Whether you appear depends on the localities and boards you list.
Which localities should I list if I live in Naharlagun?

Only those you can reach at the agreed time every week. A tutor in central Naharlagun might list Polo Colony, Barapani, Papu Nallah and Nirjuli, which sit along the same highway, and leave the Itanagar North localities for online lessons. A short, honest list is easier to keep through the monsoon.
Can I teach students elsewhere in India online from Itanagar?

Yes. Many tutors pair a few home students near where they live with online learners in other states. Home requests go to tutors close to the family first, but when a parent picks online lessons, your profile can come up for them from any city in India.
Which boards do Itanagar students follow?

Start with CBSE: its official overview lists Arunachal Pradesh's government schools among its affiliated schools. A student may instead follow CISCE's ICSE and ISC, the IB or IGCSE, and such learners can be taught at home or online. State the boards and classes you teach on your profile and confirm the school's board at the demo.
What does the ID check involve for a tutor joining from Itanagar?

Two steps: a one-time code to confirm your phone or email, and a government photo ID that the team reviews before your profile is marked Verified. Tutors who pass carry a Verified badge. It confirms identity only and is not a police or background check; /how-we-verify-tutors sets out the steps.
Do I pay to join NXTutors as a tutor?

Yes. Tutor plans are paid; /pricing sets out every plan and its features. Your teaching fee is a different matter: you fix it, and parents read it on your profile before the free first demo. Families may change tutor without charge, so careful, regular lessons are what hold on to a student.
Can a woman tutor in Itanagar take home lessons only in her own zone?

Yes. Home requests follow the localities you list, so a tutor might accept house visits only within Central Itanagar or only around Naharlagun and keep all other students online. A parent is asked to be at home for the free demo, which lets you meet the household before fixing a timetable.
Can I mix home and online lessons with one Itanagar family?

Yes. Tick both modes on your profile and settle the split with the parent once the demo is done. The monsoon is a common reason here: families often keep home lessons on dry days and move a class online when heavy rain slows the hill roads, so the student does not lose a week.
